title: SoundWeaver: Compositional Warm-Starting for Text-to-Audio Diffusion Serving
abstract: arXiv:2603.07865v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-audio (T2A) diffusion models generate high-quality audio but require tens of neural function evaluations (NFEs), resulting in substantial inference latency. Existing acceleration methods primarily optimize each generation trajectory independently, even when reusable acoustic structure exists in prior examples. We introduce SoundWeaver, the first training-free framework for compositional cross example acoustic reuse. Rather than generating from pure noise, SoundWeaver constructs a prompt-conditioned acoustic prior from segments distributed across cached audios and warm-starts diffusion from an intermediate noise level. We introduce an Acoustic Composition Graph (ACG), which uses neural codec representations and segment-level identification to identify candidate cross-cache transitions and structured path search to jointly optimize prompt relevance and acoustic continuity. translated_title: SoundWeaver：面向文本到音频扩散模型服务的组合式热启动方法
translated_abstract: 文本到音频（T2A）扩散模型能够生成高质量音频，但需要数十次神经函数评估（NFE），导致显著的推理延迟。现有加速方法主要对每条生成轨迹进行独立优化，即便先前示例中存在可复用的声学结构。我们提出SoundWeaver，这是首个无需训练的组合式跨示例声学复用框架。SoundWeaver不再从纯噪声开始生成，而是从缓存的音频中提取片段构建提示条件化的声学先验，并从中间噪声水平热启动扩散过程。我们进一步引入声学组合图（ACG），利用神经编解码器表示和片段级识别来确定跨缓存转移的候选片段，并通过结构化路径搜索联合优化提示相关性与声学连续性。我们还建立了热启动误差界限，分析了……
tldr: SoundWeaver是首个无需训练的组合式跨示例声学复用框架，通过从缓存音频片段构建提示条件化声学先验并热启动扩散过程，显著加速文本到音频扩散模型的推理。
en_tdlr: SoundWeaver is the first training-free framework enabling compositional cross-example acoustic reuse, which accelerates text-to-audio diffusion serving by constructing prompt-conditioned acoustic priors from cached audio segments and warm-starting diffusion from an intermediate noise level.
